description: The tomledit package no longer reads or writes files: ParseFile and Document.WriteFile move to the new tomlfile subpackage as tomlfile.ParseFile(path) and tomlfile.WriteFile(doc, path), with the same behavior. Migration: import github.com/stricttools/go-toml-edit/tomlfile, replace tomledit.ParseFile(path) with tomlfile.ParseFile(path), and doc.WriteFile(path) with tomlfile.WriteFile(doc, path). The root package gains ParseWithFileName(src, file), which records a file name for diagnostics without reading anything, and Document.RoundTripVerifiedBytes(file), which returns the rendered bytes only after they survive a re-parse and a re-render.
